sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Shipping Delay - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, do you know the BTR driver who's driving around Tarkov? I ordered an important delivery from him, but he just vanished somewhere. If I had a soldier like that at my disposal, I'd teach him a lesson real quick. How can you delay military cargo shipments?! He was supposed to meet with my men yesterday. I need to find that bastard and show him what responsibility means. But the package is more important at the moment. Go find it and hand it over to me. We'll deal with the driver later."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over the package from the depot on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
- 3× 5.45x39mm 7N40 ammo pack (30 pcs)
"You talked with the driver, huh? His base was attacked? If you ask me, those couriers will always make excuses for being late. But the guy did a good job hiring you. I've been dying to get this little package."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Package for Prapor | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find Prapor's package on Woods. It can be found in 1 of 2 locations in the northwest building of the train depot. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service.

It is also possible to leave the depot through walking on top of the western train. When walking on top of the train it is important to stick to the center to not get hit by snipers or mines.
